verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agent-facing integration paths: an official MCP server that any MCP-compatible agent can connect to, a Claude Code plugin, and documented use with Cursor and Gemini CLI. It never mentions LangChain, LlamaIndex, or any other RAG or agent framework integration, so only a glancing part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented first-class LangChain/LlamaIndex (or similar framework) integrations, evidence those integrations are maintained, and independent or hands-on corroboration of framework usage.
